title: LuxSit: de novo luciferases active in the laboratory
summary: The group designed new luciferases and identified three active enzymes among the initial designs. The 117-residue LuxSit catalyzes blue light with the DTZ substrate; its function is verified in the laboratory, while therapeutic or industrial applications remain prospective.

evidence.tested: Designed luciferases were tested in activity assays with synthetic luciferin substrates; the most active design had catalytic efficiency comparable to native luciferases and high substrate selectivity.
evidence.unknown: The abstract does not state how many designs were tested or how many were active, and states no explicit limitations; therapeutic or industrial applications remain untested.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning generated idealized scaffolds with binding pockets and matching sequences used to design artificial luciferases.
